about: The brawler's songs and sound effects: tools/port/build_snd.py builds the M ROM (KOF98's driver + these songs) and the V ROM (only their samples) and build/snd/songs.h (MUS_<name> = the driver command). source = the game whose driver the song comes from (kof98 = KOF98's own song, kept as is; others are ported into KOF98's format by tools/port/port98.py); cmd = the song's command in that game (docs/<game>_songs.md).

8F.what: TODO #155: KOF2000's MAX flash, the high whistle (measured in our emulator, K' and Terry: every DM's flash sends $1E $BC, every SDM's $1E $8F; $1E = slot 3, record $541E [53][1908][1936][DB], 12032 bytes, one key-on). KOF98's own $1A $8F is not used

2E.what: TODO #197: KOF96's fire hit (its hit kinds 11 / 13 / 21, handler table $16FD6: kind 11 = $1A $13 + $1A $1F, 21 = $1A $1F alone; tools/kof96/hitsfx.py, measured in our emulator: Kyo's and Krauser's fire hits): record $4536 [51][04F8][0521][DA], 10752 bytes, one key-on; every burning hit in the brawler (fighter.c hit_sfx). KOF98's own $2E (its fire crackle, another sample) is not used

sfx.what: sound.h SFX_* (swings, hits), game.json super_flash sound (3A: KOF98's DM / SDM flash) and sound_max (8F: KOF2000's SDM flash, TODO #155) and fighter.c HIT_SFX (special-move hits, named by sound + the KOF98 moves using them: TODO #64); names: the options screen's SOUND PLAYER

ssg.what: menu sounds (TODO #63): SSG cues on KOF98's own generated-sound path (command type 5), free commands $74-$77, data in the fixed area's free bytes (tools/port/ssg_cues.py); voices = SSG A, B, C: [note, ticks (13.9 ms), level 0-15]; build/snd/songs.h SSG_<name>

cues.name: CURSOR
cues.what: Fatal Fury 3's cursor (its SSG effect $60, TODO #75): its periods and levels exactly, 4 steps of 2 timer-A interrupts (36.8 ms) as 3-2-3-3 ticks (step ends within 5 ms of FF3)

cues.name: COIN
cues.what: TODO #199: KOF94's coin sound, its SSG effect song $7F (the game sends it at every credit, measured in our emulator: attract and title coins); its periods and levels register for register (raw periods), each step's start within 6.5 ms of KOF94's (its timer A 9.12 ms, the cue tick 13.85 ms): ssg_cues.py --import of the capture

voices.what: the fighters' voices (TODO #55): only the ones game.json's roster maps (export_bm.py writes build/voice_map.json), copied from each fighter's game's V ROM; one code per voice in slot 2 ($1C, players) and slot 3 ($1E, enemies), codes $11-$EF; past those (223 voices) the overflow pair, slot 4 ($1B, players) and slot 5 ($17, enemies), empty in KOF98's build (TODO #161): build/snd/voices.h
